title: A Gangster Pulls A Knife On Sam . . . And Max Runs Straight Into It (highlight)
caption:
In Weak Hero Class 1, episode 4, Rex pulls a knife on Sam. Then Max runs straight in. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom

segments.say: Rex pulls a *knife* on Sam, and there is nowhere left to run.
To see how it got here, go back to the theme park, where a real officer shows up, gun *drawn*.
But Rex smooths it over. A misunderstanding, he says. Didn't we play *soccer* together?
While they talk, Rex slips away, and Sam runs after *him*.
Deep in the park, Sam finally catches up with him. Not this kid *again*, Rex groans.
Rex knocks him down, and pulls a *knife*.
Then someone shouts. It's *Max*, running in.
There's no other way, he says. You need a good *beating*.
It gets ugly fast. Rex chokes Max, and Sam ends up flat on the *ground*.
Rex pins Max down and keeps *hitting*. But Max still has one more move left in him.
